id: title:adamleithp:add quill ui rules to design md

review.posthog_relevance: Establishes documented conventions for frontend component sizing, dropdown behavior, and scrolling implementation, potentially reducing UI inconsistency and accessibility issues in the PostHog web application.
review.reason: This chunk consists entirely of documentation changes to `frontend/src/design.md`. No implementation, tests, or configuration changes are supplied. The score is assigned based on the established documentation conventions, not on demonstrated code behavior.
review.uncertainty: This score relies solely on documentation updates. While this establishes a convention, the actual implementation and its behavior are not demonstrated in this chunk, so the benefit is potential rather than realized. No tier 2 or 3 evidence exists.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only documentation changes to frontend/src/design.md. No implementation, tests, or configuration changes are supplied. No score can be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation guidance for button sizing, select/combobox trigger sizing, scrolling behavior, and typography/icon usage.
observations.code_quote: - Size: buttons and select or picker triggers use the default size (`size="icon"` when icon-only). Use `sm` or `xs` only for a special case, such as a dense table cell, or when the design asks for it
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes a documented convention for frontend component sizing and accessibility, potentially reducing inconsistent UI implementation across the PostHog web app.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation guidance that Select and Combobox triggers follow button size rules, while popup items remain default size.
observations.code_quote: - Select and Combobox triggers follow the button size rule. Their popup items are always default size, so an `sm` trigger opens a menu bigger than itself. This includes a `Button` that opens a picker
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies expected behavior for dropdown menu sizing, potentially preventing layout inconsistencies in picker components.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation guidance for scrolling behavior, including the use of CSS-only fade and ScrollArea, and compatibility notes for Firefox and reduced-motion users.
observations.code_quote: - Default: a plain scroller with an edge fade, `overflow-y-auto scroll-mask-y-4 scroll-py-4`. This is the pattern quill's menus, Select and Combobox use. The fade is CSS only, while `ScrollArea` runs JavaScript and React state updates on every scroll
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes a documented pattern for scrolling and compatibility, potentially improving accessibility and performance consistency in menu and dialog components.
